lenses.name: Discovery autonomy
lenses.question: When an autonomous agent encounters a NOVEL intent it has never seen before, can SatRank route it to a SUITABLE endpoint without any human curation step? Does the catalog (192 endpoints, 27 categories, 5 providers = 77%) cover the surface-area an autonomous agent will plausibly need over a year of operation? Is the discovery surface (categories + keywords + free-text intent) machine-grokkable with low ambiguity, or does it need an LLM in the loop to interpret SatRank's response?

lenses.name: Identity & reputation portability
lenses.question: Can an autonomous agent build, prove, and PORT its identity and reputation across (a) sessions, (b) restarts, (c) other systems (MCP, A2A, ANP)? Currently agents identify via NIP-98 Nostr pubkey, operators via DNS TXT attestation. Is this a sufficient identity primitive for a fully autonomous agent that operates 24/7 for years? Can an agent's good behaviour earn it discount/rate-limit/credit benefits that compound? Can a rogue agent be evicted or bond-slashed?

lenses.name: Capital sovereignty & delegation
lenses.question: Can an autonomous agent own and control its OWN sats budget without trusting a custodian? Currently SatRank holds a custodial token_balance v1 plus a non-custodial hold-invoice mode. Can an agent (a) deposit sats once and spend over weeks, (b) delegate a sub-budget to a child agent with a hard ceiling, (c) recover funds if SatRank itself goes offline, (d) prove balance to a third party without trusting SatRank's API? Are LSP/lndhub/cashu/fedimint patterns considered or adopted?

lenses.name: Failure recovery autonomy
lenses.question: When something goes wrong (operator misbehaves, validator disagrees, dispute opens, evidence challenged, refund delayed, claim rejected), can the agent recover and continue operation WITHOUT a human in the loop? Is every state transition machine-walkable with no UI/email/Slack escalation? Does every error code carry a programmatic next-action hint? Can the agent automatically blacklist, retry, dispute, claim-bond, and adjust its strategy from observed outcomes?

lenses.name: Composition / agent-to-agent economy
lenses.question: Can an autonomous agent BECOME a service-provider in SatRank's catalog? Can agents pay other agents (not just human-operated APIs)? Is there an earn/spend symmetry that lets an agent finance its own consumption by serving others? Can a meta-agent compose/orchestrate several worker agents and bill upstream? Is the system's identity/bond/evidence/claim semantics able to handle a fully programmatic operator (an agent serving as an L402 endpoint)?

lenses.name: Long-horizon adversarial robustness
lenses.question: Over months of unattended operation against active adversaries, does SatRank's economic security hold? Examine: (a) Sybil attacks on agents and operators, (b) collusion between operator + validator to fake delivery, (c) replay/double-claim against bonds, (d) bond exhaustion (operator runs out of stake), (e) drift in posteriors (slow-poisoning the rank), (f) evidence chain integrity over time, (g) governance of bad actors. What is the WORST adversarial scenario that an autonomous agent ecosystem on SatRank survives, and what's the first one that breaks it?
